description: This file declares the external API for cryptographic functions related to a Crypto Object in the ANSC framework. It includes license and copyright information, module details, environment, author, and revision history. The primary content is the declaration of the function 'AnscCreateCryptoPub' which is implemented elsewhere.

methods.name: AnscCreateCryptoPub
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to a Crypto Public Object, given an owner context handle.
